Hi Anna,

My name is Roland Jacobs; I work as a designer and book services specialist, helping authors present and promote their books.

While researching recent releases, I found Beyond the Sea and Cove Harbor Comeuppance. I was particularly interested in Joe Banks attending his ex's cruise-ship wedding and becoming the prime suspect in Beyond the Sea, and waking after too many tequilas to a murder he cannot remember in Cove Harbor Comeuppance.

Those details gave me an idea for how a 12-month marketing roadmap could help present your books to more of the readers who may enjoy them. A month-by-month plan could use Joe Banks attending his ex's cruise-ship wedding and becoming the prime suspect as the anchor, pacing promotions and series reminders across the year.

Happy to put a complimentary concept sample together if you'd find it helpful.

Would you be open to that?

Warm regards,
Roland Jacobs
